name: @vaipakam/agent
description: Vaipakam agent Cloudflare Worker (Stage 3 PR4 of the Worker split — see docs/DesignsAndPlans/Stage3WorkerSplitPlan.md). Owns proactive notifications (periodic interest pre-notify, push + telegram dispatchers), public Farcaster Frame at /frames/active-loans, operator services (server-side aggregator quote proxies at /quote/{0x,1inch}), the Telegram bot webhook (/tg/webhook), the diagnostics record capture endpoint (/diag/record), and the frontend-facing settings endpoints (/thresholds PUT + /link/telegram POST). Holds aggregator API keys + Push channel signer + Telegram bot token. Holds NO on-chain transaction key (KEEPER_PRIVATE_KEY moved to apps/keeper), so it cannot move funds DIRECTLY — not the same as fund-safe: via the shared database-scoped D1 binding it can corrupt state the signing keeper acts on (#1722). It does hold PUSH_CHANNEL_PK, a real Ethereum key used to sign Push notifications. The older 'a compromised agent produces stale data' claim is withdrawn: this Worker deletes diagnostics/support records, writes loans, notifies real users, publishes listings, and shares a database-scoped D1 binding with the signing Worker (see #1722).
